title: Senior - Product Analyst - Generalist
description:
Withum is a place where talent thrives \- where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results. Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 The Innovation team is seeking a Senior Product Analyst within India. This role sits at the intersection of our Industry practices and our product development efforts, analyzing complex tax and business processes to be solved with automation and artificial intelligence. The Senior Product Analyst partners directly with accounting professionals to understand how work actually gets done, then translates that understanding into clear requirements, user stories, and delivered product capability.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive \- to be in a position of strength. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





**How You’ll Spend Your Time** 




 • Acting as the primary interface between the Innovation team and the firm’s practice and Product managers translating process pain points into product requirements
 



 • Partnering with subject matter experts across compliance, provision, and advisory to document current\-state workflows and identify opportunities
 



 • Leading requirements definition and delivery for tax/audit\-focused products, including client intake, workpaper automation, document extraction, and review workflows
 



 • Writing user stories and acceptance criteria based on business\-driven functionality as well as technical capabilities (working with both the Product Owner and Innovation team)
 



 • Building and executing test scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing with teams, and triaging defects through resolution
 



 • Assisting with execution of product delivery and services which includes benefit realization (ROI of new products, features, tools, services, etc.)
 



 • Helping the Innovation team align change catalysts to ensure successful adoption and utilization of products within the Firm
 



 • Facilitating knowledge sessions, demonstrations, and training with subject matter experts and stakeholders across the firm
 



 • Tracking adoption, usage, and time savings, and reporting results back to Innovation and Practice leadership
 



 • Participating in sprint planning and project/process specification meetings
 



 • Understanding data movement and detailed knowledge of upstream and downstream systems, including accounting software platforms, and the interactions and dependencies between them
 



 • Seeking awareness of product scope (e.g. MVP) and providing input to define clear user stories to inform product development
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • Required Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Technology, Information Technology, or Management Information Systems
 



 • Required Years of Experience: 6\+ years’ experience preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including building or configuring Copilot agents, prompt design, and evaluating AI\-generated output
 



 • Familiarity with accounting technology platforms and document automation tools used in a professional services environment
 



 • Experience running user acceptance testing, writing test scripts, and managing defect triage
 



 • Agile and product management certifications with experience with Azure DevOps and User Story creation
 



 • Progress toward or desire to obtain Prosci and/or PMP certification
 



 • Strong personal and communication skills both written and verbal; ability to develop relationships with all stakeholders
 



 • Exhibits willingness to try new ideas, even when different than status quo
 



 • Ability to work with several technology platforms including Microsoft Office and various innovative tools and systems such as but not limited to Agile to define clear user stories
 



 • Ability to prepare charts, tables and diagrams to assist in analyzing problems, utilizing, if necessary, various business, scientific and/or engineering mathematical techniques
 



 • Responsive and ability to manage multiple projects and communications simultaneously
 



 • Excellent attention to detail; ability to multitask and adapt to shifting needs and priorities
 



 • Able to learn and adapt to new and complex procedures quickly
 



 • Excellent time management skills
 



  





 Website:
 
 www.withum.com
 




  





***Withum will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran.***

title: Officer, Quality Control Testing
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 This role is responsible for conducting in\-process and final product quality analyses and inspections in strict compliance with established standards and regulatory requirements within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The incumbent interprets and evaluates analytical results in terms of accuracy and precision against predefined specifications to ensure product integrity. Various measuring devices, testing equipment, and predetermined methods are employed to accept or reject products based on prescribed specifications. The role contributes to identifying ongoing quality issues and preventing potential production problems through proactive monitoring and timely escalation. Manufacturing process deviations and defects in finished goods are identified, documented, and reported in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices. Random samples of finished goods are tested to verify conformance with internal and regulatory quality standards. The position supports continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting enhancements to testing methods and quality processes. It operates within a structured quality management framework aligned with 21 CFR Part 210 and 211, ICH guidelines, and applicable Indian and international pharmaceutical regulations.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Perform in\-process and final product quality analyses and inspections in compliance with regulatory and internal standards
* Interpret and evaluate analytical results for accuracy and precision against established specifications
* Operate measuring devices, testing equipment, and follow predetermined methods to accept or reject products
* Test random samples of finished goods to verify conformance with quality specifications
* Report manufacturing process deviations and defects in finished goods to relevant stakeholders
* Identify ongoing quality issues and recommend preventive measures to avoid potential production problems
* Maintain accurate and complete documentation of all testing activities in accordance with GDP and GMP requirements
* Support implementation of corrective and preventive actions arising from quality investigations


**Additional Responsibilities**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
**Education**
* B. Pharm B. Pharm \- Required
* M. Pharm M. Pharm \- Preferred


**Experience:**
* 1 year or more in 1 \- 4 Years

**Licenses:**

* Knowledge of audit preparation and audit compliance.

* Ability to identify process gaps and implement corrective/preventive actions.

title: SF QA Engineer
description:
**About Astound Digital**
 At Astound Digital, we are pioneers in the digital landscape, dedicated to transforming how the world interacts with technology, data, and creativity. Our role as trusted advisors in the digital landscape empowers the world’s most innovative brands with frictionless, end\-to\-end customer experiences. We are known for our comprehensive solutions, proven expertise, and collaborative, nimble approach that instills confidence in our clients. We embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation, efficiency, and better outcomes for our clients and employees. Join us to navigate and lead in the ever\-changing digital world, where your impact will extend beyond the ordinary.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The QA Engineer will be part of a high\-performance, feature\-driven QA team responsible for building and testing complex Salesforce Core solutions. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of solving technical challenges, taking ownership of quality objectives, and driving testing excellence throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) within an Agile framework.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Requirements Analysis: Analyze business, functional, and technical specifications for Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud) solutions.
* Test Planning \& Design: Create comprehensive test cases and scenarios in JIRA/Zephyr to ensure full requirements coverage.
* Test Execution: Execute planned test cases across desktop, mobile, and tablet environments, ensuring rigorous validation.
* Integration Testing: Conduct rigorous testing for third\-party services and external components within the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Defect Management: Log detailed bug reports in tracking systems, manage the defect lifecycle, and perform thorough retesting and verification of fixes.
* Collaboration \& Agile Participation: Actively participate in daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and brainstorming sessions to address technical issues and quality risks.
* Estimation \& Reporting: Provide accurate effort estimations for tasks and maintain clear, consistent test results and quality status reporting for stakeholders.
* Process Improvement: Propose and implement enhancements to QA\-related procedures, tools, and systems in collaboration with the QA Lead and Project Managers.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Experience: 3–5 years of professional software testing experience, with at least 3 years specifically focused on testing Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud) platforms.
* Methodologies: Hands\-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and Zephyr or similar test management tools.
* Core Competencies: Strong background in requirements analysis, test execution, bug lifecycle management, and testing effort estimation.
* Preferred Certification: Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant.
* Soft Skills: Strong team player with high adaptability to dynamic environments and intermediate\-to\-advanced written and verbal English communication skills for effective global collaboration.


 What we offer in return
   

  

* Global Collaboration: The opportunity to work daily with diverse and talented professionals across the globe.
* Off\-the\-Charts Career Growth: Сlear career path and a performance review system, career coaching, training and certifications, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Well\-being Is Top Priority: Parental leave, paid time off, comprehensive health and medical plans.
* Real Work\-Life Balance: Dependent on location, we offer remote, in\-office, or hybrid working modes; flexible hours; work\-life balance support on every stage and level.


 Why work for Astound Digital?
   

  

 Whether you’re working directly with our world\-renowned clients or with your Astound colleagues from around the globe, you will shape the future of digital commerce, using emerging technologies and innovative approaches.
   

  

**Grow your career with Astound Digital, and discover exciting opportunities while doing the work you love!**

Job Description – Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Position: Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Department: Quality / Electrical
 



 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
 



 Experience: 2–5 Years
 



 Location: Ahmedabad / Project Sites
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Inspect and verify electrical materials, equipment, and installation work as per approved drawings and specifications.
 



 • Conduct quality inspections and testing of electrical systems, panels, cables, transformers, earthing, lighting, and related equipment.
 



 • Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and applicable electrical codes.
 



 • Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, and method statements for quality requirements.
 



 • Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, test reports, NCRs, and quality documentation.
 



 • Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, consultants, and clients for quality inspections and approvals.
 



 • Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
 



 • Monitor workmanship and ensure proper installation practices at project sites.
 



 • Conduct material inspection and verify test certificates and quality documents.
 



 • Support internal and external quality audits.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation and maintain project quality records.
 



 •    Prepare and maintain HOTO (Handing Over \& Taking Over) documentation for completed electrical works.
 



 • Coordinate with site, project, and client teams for smooth project handover.
 



 • Verify that all electrical installations, testing, commissioning, and quality requirements are completed before handover.
 



 • Ensure submission of as\-built drawings, test reports, inspection reports, O\&M manuals, warranties, and other handover documents.
 



 • Conduct joint inspections with the client/consultant and close all pending observations and punch points.
 



 • Maintain proper records of HOTO documents and obtain necessary approvals/sign\-offs.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Good knowledge of electrical systems, testing, and installation.
 



 • Knowledge of electrical drawings and technical specifications.
 



 • Knowledge of quality control procedures and inspection techniques.
 



 • Familiarity with IS/IEC standards and electrical safety requirements.
 



 • Good communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office and basic documentation.
 



 • Ability to work independently and at project sites.
 



 Preferred
 



 • Experience in Electrical EPC / MEP / Industrial Projects.
 



 • Knowledge of QA/QC documentation and NCR/CAPA procedures.
 



 • Experience in handling client/consultant inspections.
